title: Building Holographic Entanglement by Measurement
abstract: Proposes a framework for preparing quantum states whose entanglement entropies are governed by minimal surfaces in a chosen bulk geometry, obeying the Ryu-Takayanagi formula. Method: select bulk geometry, discretize into coupling graph (bulk + boundary nodes), evolve under graph interactions, measure bulk nodes to prepare boundary state. Uses only Gaussian operations and measurements, making it implementable on photonic and cold-atom platforms. Numerical demonstrations show approximate reproduction of Ryu-Takayanagi predictions in hyperbolic disk and wormhole geometries.
key_claims: Measurement-based preparation of holographic entanglement states
Entanglement entropies governed by Ryu-Takayanagi minimal surfaces
Implementable with Gaussian operations on photonic and cold-atom platforms
Numerically demonstrated on hyperbolic disk and wormhole geometries
Bypasses need for full tensor network construction
